payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the main motivation of the paper is to evaluate the effectiveness of error type predictions in grammatical error correction (GEC) and to highlight the challenges associated with correcting multi-token edits.

claims.text: The main motivation of the paper is to evaluate how well humans believe the predicted error types characterize each edit in grammatical error correction (GEC).
The paper emphasizes the need for more sophisticated methods for correcting multi-token edits in GEC, as current systems struggle with these types of errors.
